injuryBoundaryReview.limitation: Literal printed NFL play injury annotations and injury/return updates are retained. An update without a complete printed exit-to-return interval remains UNRESOLVED and is not converted into a full-game or partial-game numerical loss.

specialistReview.safeguard: Special-teams-only participation does not establish a defensive replacement effect.

blockers.finding: The complete official final, starter, substitute, DNP, inactive, quarterback, specialist and printed injury-sequence evidence is assembled for both teams, but 7 existing fail-closed personnel cases still require governed reconciliation.
blockers.footballImpact: The new evidence can resolve status and actual duty questions, but values and distinct replacement credit must still be computed without double counting.
blockers.nextAction: Reconcile every listed unresolvedNumericalCase through the existing value/replacement owner, then compute the paired injury interval and validate together.

blockers.finding: The gamebook prints injury annotations and status/return notices, but not every sequence supplies a complete exit-to-return interval.

blockers.nextAction: Use the explicit play-by-play injury annotations and participation intervals where complete; otherwise preserve the boundary as unknown and do not manufacture precision.
